400 Bad Request when uploading a file with invalid purpose

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.create_file_async(LiterLlm::CreateFileRequest.new(file: 'data.jsonl', purpose: 'invalid-purpose'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
